name: Emaar The Economic City
summary: Emaar The Economic City engages in the development of real estate properties in the economic or other zones in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates in five segments: Residential Business, Industrial Development, Hospitality and Leisure, Education Services, and City Operations. The company primarily develops the King Abdullah Economic City. It also develops infrastructure; promotes, markets, and sells land within development areas; transfers/leases land; develops buildings/housing units; and constructs properties on behalf of other parties.
